prompts.td-props: Create a production transparent 2D wuxia environment PROP ATLAS based ONLY on SELECTED LOWER B panel of attached arena concept. TD-B wartime night fortress: TOP LEFT a damaged traditional stone city GATEHOUSE with black tiled roof, torn red banners and warm firelit windows; TOP RIGHT a wooden WATCHTOWER with a burning brazier at top and torn red banner; BOTTOM LEFT a compact ruined BARRACKS building with glowing amber interior and charred roof; BOTTOM RIGHT a traditional red war BANNER on a heavy stone foot with a small brazier beside it. No magic portal, no shop, no armies, no standalone terrain. EXACTLY four fully isolated objects in a strict 2x2 grid. Each complete object fits inside central 80 percent of its own cell, generous transparent gutters, no cropping or overlap. Native RGBA alpha. Consistent elevated orthographic three-quarter top-down gameplay camera matching reference, rich crisp hand-painted sprite detail, NOT cinematic perspective or isometric grid. Source light upper-left with subtle night blue and warm amber accents. Preserve all roof tips/branches, foot/contact centered at bottom of each cell. No baked cast shadows, no background, no ground tile, NO color wash behind objects, no outer glow, no labels/text/UI. These are independent Y-sorted props; terrain and dynamic shading supplied separately. Original artwork.
